thread:
alex: Heads up — drafting the internal release note for tomorrow's deploy (02:00-04:00 PT). Plan: canary -> gradual -> full. Need a short blurb for SRE/oncall + a pinned model-version line. Also want explicit rollback triggers (error spike, latency, eval regressions).

maria: I can draft the SRE blurb. For pinning, propose `model: redwood-rlhf-v2.3.1` and `embed-model: embed-alpha-2026-03`. Keep fallback to `v2.2.9`? :thinking:

alex: Yes fallback `v2.2.9` is the fallback lane. Canary audience note should say '5% of production traffic' in the internal blurb.

claire: I'll take company-facing copy + the internal blurb. Two quick variants: short (ops) and expanded (all-hands). Short: "Deploying model v2.3.1 — 5% canary, rollback plan ready." Expanded: will include bullets and a short why. Drafting now. :memo:

claire: Draft long copy (paste):
```
Release notes — v2.3.1
- ~12% throughput improvement for typical chat workloads
- KV-cache persistence fix (reduces cold-start latency)
- Tokenization edge-case fix for complex emoji sequences
- Quantization adjustments: may see small quality diffs on a subset of prompts

Rollout plan:
- 02:15 PT: 5% canary for 30m
- 02:45 PT: 25% for 60m (if metrics stable)
- 03:45 PT: 100% gradual roll to completion

Pinning:
- primary: redwood-rlhf-v2.3.1
- fallback: redwood-rlhf-v2.2.9

Rollback criteria (ops):
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- 95p latency increase > 150ms vs baseline for 5m
- Automated eval: quality drop > 5% on safety/prompt set

If rollback occurs, follow the rollback playbook and notify #incidents + execs.
```

sam: Adding concrete thresholds from oncall side: 5xx > 0.5% for 5m = immediate pause/rollback. 95th latency +150ms for 5m = pause and investigate. If automated evals show >5% regression on the baseline prompt suite, treat as rollback. Also: watch P50 for any jump >200ms (early signal).

alex: Good, please add those exact numbers to the short SRE blurb.

maria: One more ask — include the model pin line we can copy into the deploy config: `model_pin: redwood-rlhf-v2.3.1; fallback: redwood-rlhf-v2.2.9; rollout: 5,25,100`

alex: Deploy-bot, schedule canary at 02:15 PT and attach job id.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by @alex — job_id=rb-20260316-01; start=2026-03-16T02:15:00-07:00; target=canary(5%); model=redwood-rlhf-v2.3.1; monitor=ops-slo,eval-watch. :robot_face:

maria: I'll put the RN doc up at https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-16-v2.3.1 and add the short blurb for #eng-releases and #sre.

oncall: I'll be on primary for the window 02:00-05:00 PT. If we hit rollback criteria, who will execute the rollback?

alex: I'll be able to initiate rollback if oncall confirms the signal. Claire will own external comms (exec + customers if needed). Sam, do you want the ops-runbook link in the thread?

sam: Yes — add `https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback-v2` and make sure the runbook has the exact CLI command: `deployctl rollback --job rb-20260316-01 --to redwood-rlhf-v2.2.9`.

claire: Noted. I'll also prepare a short notification template for execs and for a wider email if we have to roll back. Draft template: "We paused the rollout of v2.3.1 at X after observing a spike in errors. We are rolling back to v2.2.9. We will follow up with a post-mortem."

alex: Final asks before I pin: 1) React :thumbsup: if you approve the short ops blurb, 2) confirm deploy-bot job_id is correct, 3) anyone object to publishing internal announce at 01:00 PT tomorrow?

maria: :thumbsup: approve short blurb. job_id matches. No objections.

sam: :thumbsup: on thresholds and runbook link.

oncall: :eyes: I'll be listening for alerts. No objections.

claire: :thumbsup: copy approved. I'll be on standby for comms.

alex: Thanks — I'll pin the short blurb to #eng-releases at 01:00 PT and send the company-facing note at 01:30 PT if nothing changes. If anyone spots a missing detail, drop it here before 23:00 PT.
